protocol.noise: contiguous 8-step lag-model tracking residuals from non-panel episodes, subtracted from commanded xyz targets; same snippets at every state
protocol.hold: nominal chunk final target (gripper included) for every probe
protocol.oracle: any neighbor with start tilt <45 deg ends hold step 30 at >=45 deg
protocol.grades: mixed if both outcomes >= 2/64; unanimous if all agree; weak otherwise
protocol.proxy_warning: tracking residuals are an execution-variation proxy; the simulated controller also lags, so lag may be double counted
